items.title: PhD opportunity: photonics for the scale up of quantum sensors
items.content: Applications are open through the EPSRC DLA funding competition (October 2027 entry) for a project aiming to build towards a 64-pixel diamond quantum sensor array on silicon photonics. Deadline 17:00 GMT, 13 January 2027.

items.title: Quantum Dot Day — 26 November 2026
items.content: Save the date for Quantum Dot Day at Sheffield Town Hall. Connect, collaborate, and discover the latest breakthroughs in the semiconductor and quantum dot landscape. Register interest on the event page.

items.title: ARIA seed project: quantum sensors for magnetobiotics
items.content: Joe is co-PI with Kieran Bates (Bates Lab) on an ARIA seed project developing chip-integrated quantum sensors to track magnetically labelled microbes.

items.title: Photonic-integrated quantum sensor array published in Nature Communications
items.content: Our eight-sensor photonic-integrated NV array, with simultaneous, independent readout, is published in Nature Communications, with colleagues at the University of Bristol.
